usage: jbus word [-h] (--to PROJECT | --all) [--message THREAD/MESSAGE]
                 [--from THREAD] [--page FILE] [--scope SCOPE]

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --to PROJECT          the project or the scratch home whose home it is for
  --all                 the home of every project
  --message THREAD/MESSAGE
                        the user's own message in T3 Code, which jbus reads
                        for the words and the time
  --from THREAD         the thread running this: a word recorded by a
                        project's home is not posted to it
  --page FILE           the page the word was given on: the word goes to the
                        home whose page it is
  --scope SCOPE         a scoped home the user's message goes to, given again
                        for each, or every
